description: Recorded planner write_result payloads for the brief 'triage the dependencies of https://github.com/expressjs/express'. `valid` is a good DAG; `cycle` and `orphanInput` are the invalid shapes the correction round must catch.
brief: Triage the dependencies of https://github.com/expressjs/express for known vulnerabilities and write a prioritized remediation report.

subtasks.title: Inventory dependencies
subtasks.description: Read package.json and the lockfile via GitHub contents; list runtime dependencies with resolved versions. Done when every dependency has a name and version.

subtasks.title: Query vulnerabilities
subtasks.description: Query OSV (Advisory fallback) for every dependency in the inventory. Done when each dependency has a vulnerability list or an explicit unknown.

subtasks.title: Assess upgrade risk
subtasks.description: For each vulnerable dependency read release notes between current and fixed versions. Done when each has a breaking-change risk or unknown.

subtasks.title: Write remediation report
subtasks.description: Write the prioritized remediation report from the blackboard. Done when every vulnerable dependency has a fixed version, risk and action, and unknowns are listed.
